items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: And so he wanted me to show Tyree, and I showed Tyree. I was helping Tyree on a lot of those things.

ctx.x: But Louis kept me up all night, up until about 9:00 o'clock in the morning, showing Tyree how to do these spots with him that -- because how I really got to doing well was Louis helped me, you know. He'd say, now, when I get -- when I mug like this, you do that or you do this, and over the long period of time I worked with him, I picked up a lot of those little mannerisms to do with working with him.

And so he wanted me to show Tyree, and I showed Tyree. I was helping Tyree on a lot of those things. See, Louis -- anybody could have learned from Louis. I had a long discussion with John Hendricks one time. We went up to Monterey, and I don't know if you remember this particular year, and Dave Brubeck and his wife had written a thing called 'The Real Ambassadors.' In fact, it's out on a record.
